name: Meidou Hazuki
source:
Witch of "pride" lineage. Although she's from a countryside, she's still the next head of old Meidou hosuehold and her personality is just as you can imagine.

Although she's forceful, she's also straightforward and pure. Despite her elitist thinking, she can be a clutz, suddenly getting full of herself and acting like she knows it all. Despite being quite disappointing in many ways, somehow no one can get to hate her. Basically, Hazuki is quite a simple girl. 

Because she was raised in a remoute mountain village she's bad with the city and hates ramen for being junk food (or at least that's what she says to maintain her image). She would still eat ramen when asked to and her favorite are tonkotsu and soy sauce-based ramen.

Favorite foods: Fashionable things, food & watermelon
Disliked things: Dogs, being looked down upon
